_comment: CAS numbers for rows the source sheet left blank, wrote as #VALUE!, or recorded differently from the published catalogue. Keyed by product id. A string sets one CAS, replacing whatever the sheet holds; a list of {label, cas} declares a product sold - or registered - in more than one form. Every CAS is validated against the official check-digit algorithm before it is emitted.
_provenance: Each verified against multiple independent references (ChemicalBook, Sigma-Aldrich, PubChem, USP, TCI, Cayman Chemical) in August 2026. Entries added in September 2026 are marked below with the catalogue row that prompted them.

_no_cas_exists.branched-chain-amino-acids: A blend of L-leucine (61-90-5), L-isoleucine (73-32-5) and L-valine (72-18-4). A mixture has no single CAS.

_removed.kinds-of-beef-organs-powder: Removed from the catalogue - not a defined chemical substance.

_note_hydroxypropyl_beta_cyclodextrin: One substance, two live registrations. 128446-35-5 is the number verified for the sheet; 94035-02-6 is the one printed in the catalogue. Both are carried so a buyer searching either finds the page.
_note_1_2_iodoethyl_4_octylbenzene: The sheet gave this the CAS of 4-octylphenethyl methanesulfonate (162358-06-7), the row above it in the catalogue. 162358-07-8 is the iodoethyl compound's own number.

_not_published.erbium-hydroxide: The catalogue lists 'Erbium hydroxide' as an Irbesartan intermediate against CAS 138401-24-8, which is irbesartan itself; erbium hydroxide is 14646-16-3. Name and number contradict each other, so the row is held back until the sheet says which was meant.
